reviews.body: The overdue query selects paid, void, and draft invoices, so the reminder job will target invoices that are not collectible. The new endpoint also has no test coverage; typechecking and the seven existing helper tests pass.

comments.body:
🟠 **P1** · 🐛 **Bug**

`paid_at is null` does not mean an invoice is unpaid: paid invoices from before the column was added have no timestamp, and draft/void invoices also keep it null. Running this predicate on production returns 2,056 paid, 636 void, and 14 draft invoices alongside 465 sent invoices; the first page contains 24 paid invoices and one void invoice. The reminder job will therefore send payment demands for settled, canceled, and unsent invoices. Filter explicitly with `i.status = 'sent'` and `i.due_date < current_date` in both the row query and the count query.

🟡 **P2** · 🐛 **Bug**

The new endpoint has no tests: all seven existing tests exercise helpers, so they pass even when the reminder selection includes paid, void, and draft invoices. Add endpoint/query tests covering all four statuses (including a historical paid invoice with null `paid_at`), yesterday versus today, and pagination with matching totals and deterministic oldest-first ordering. This selection determines who receives a payment reminder.
